Updated the existing `treasury-bulletin-federal-debt` skill with the generalizable pitfall:

- For pre-FY1977 federal fiscal years, FY end is June 30.
- For plain “public debt outstanding,” do not use agency securities, guaranteed obligations, or statutory limitation totals unless explicitly asked.
- For BLS CPI-U annual average 1982-84=100 NSA, OfficeQA expects the published one-decimal annual averages, e.g. 1960=29.6, 1961=29.9, 1962=30.3.
- Keep values in millions and round only the final difference.

Also updated durable memory with the compact version of this debt/CPI rule.
